topology.notes: Top module sram_wrapper instantiates one hard macro (sky130_sram_1kbyte_1rw1r_32x256_8, blackboxed for synthesis via EXTRA_VERILOG_MODELS / MACROS config) plus an 8-bit free-running address counter and a 64-bit output register placed at the macro boundary. sequential_element_estimate = 8 (address counter) + 64 (dout0/dout1 registers) = 72 flip-flops in the wrapper's own std-cell logic; the macro's internal storage (256x32b) is not counted here since it's a blackboxed macro, not synthesized std-cell sequential logic.

unverified: timing on 27 macro pin(s) is extrapolated beyond the liberty's characterisation: worst is u_sram/web0 at 0.460 ns against a model characterised to 0.040 ns (11.5x past the last table entry, corner max_ss_100C_1v60) — these delays are off the end of the table, not measurements, and signoff needs a re-characterised liberty.
